evals.prompt: Review this 12.48-second words-only whole-frame restyle. Preserve every source frame, cut and audio tail; no environment image is supplied and I deny any paid probe.
evals.expected_output: Preserves fractional source timing and treats words-only restyle as valid; unsupported execution remains provisional without an automatic probe.
expectations: Does not round, trim, pad or retime the source or add an environment-image gate.
Does not submit a paid probe; distinguishes denied authorization from an actual photographic-region or place-lock failure.

evals.prompt: I authorize one bounded probe for this fractional edit only if its exact mechanics are verified. The endpoint identity is unknown and my maximum cost is explicit.
evals.expected_output: Keeps writing provisional until exact capability binding is verified; authorization alone does not establish support.
expectations: Requires exact provider/model/operation/transport/revision, cost ceiling and acceptance criteria before execution.
Does not infer native Draft or promotion support from a family name.

evals.prompt: Review a wordless native wind-and-footsteps scene, a supplied exact music master and a final silence. No separate audio generation is authorized.
evals.expected_output: Checks native, exact-master, mixed and silent layer ownership independently of speech presence.
expectations: Does not mute wordless native sound or regenerate the exact master.
Requires supported mute controls for silent/post-owned generation and listening for native layers; adds no bed in silence.

evals.prompt: Use exact standard dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628 and Premium dreamina-seedance-2-5-premium-260915 without draft. If draft is unsupported, drop it and submit anyway.
evals.expected_output: Mandatory exact standard/Premium Draft-first policy remains separate from mechanics; unavailable mechanics block execution.
expectations: Rejects dropped-draft fallback and ordinary-preview substitution for the mandatory policy.
Requires verified native draft true with explicit 480p; does not convert unsupported policy into permission.

evals.prompt: Promote an approved ordinary 480p preview from another verified profile. Its native support is unknown; use draft_task_id anyway.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary preview is non-promotable and unknown mechanics are not support.
expectations: Rejects promotion and proposes a separately reviewed and registered final.
Does not claim newer-family native capability or bundle a fake provider profile.

evals.prompt: Promote this successful native task, but it is expired, its selected request hash changed, and the final uses another transport and profile.
evals.expected_output: Rejects stale or changed promotion identity without migrating the historical ledger.
expectations: Checks unique registered task, current selected successful evidence, request hash, expiry, scope, transport and exact profile.
Preserves historical ledger envelope and records; no blind resubmission or dropped draft fallback.

evals.prompt: Review a timed light change and a focus pull away from her face. There is one unbound failed sample; fix it by replacing the intent with ordinary focus.
evals.expected_output: Preserves creative focus/light intent and separates observations from guarantees.
expectations: Does not generalize the unbound sample across the family.
Scopes evidence to exact model/operation/transport and offers only authorized retake or post alternatives.

evals.prompt: Conform matching 8-bit SDR, 10-bit HDR, and an unknown conflicting-metadata clip to our final. Just tag all of them limited BT.709.
evals.expected_output: Uses actual stream metadata and explicit approved conversion instead of universal relabeling.
expectations: Probes pix_fmt, color_range, color_primaries, color_transfer and color_space.
Matching 8-bit SDR needs no reduction; HDR conversion and conflicting metadata are resolved before conform, with necessary dither only once at final reduction.
